title: Executive Operations Integrator
description:
Overview

Role : Executive Operations Integrator (Beauty Industry - MUST HAVE EXPERIENCE)

Role Specifics : We are only considering candidates with experience in the beauty industry. Please only apply if you have worked in the beauty industry / salon space.

Contract : Full-time Remote Contractor (40 hours weekly / 160 hours monthly)

Business Hours : Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM EST

Rate : $2,000 - $3,000 USD monthly / $24,000 - $36,000 annually (salary is negotiable based on experience and location)

Availability to Start : Immediately

Client's Profile

Founded in New Jersey in 1997, this award-winning luxury salon and wellness spa is more than a destination for beauty; it's a space for transformation, self-expression, and connection. With multiple locations and a commitment to continuous growth, they've cultivated a brand rooted in intentional service, elevated aesthetics, and deep care for their clients and team. Grounded in a culture of excellence and evolution, the company is led by a visionary founder who blends business with purpose, creating a salon experience that is as soul-filled as it is stylish. Their dedication to excellence has earned them national recognition, including features in major media outlets and accolades from platforms such as CBS and The Knot.

What You\'ll Do

As the Executive Operations Integrator, this role is not a traditional operations assistant role, and it\'s not suited for a traditional candidate. The client is building more than a business. They are nurturing a vision of trust, growth and collaborative improvement. As the Executive Operations Integrator, you are the trusted partner who supports the founder from behind the scenes, with clear systems, executive presence, and emotional intelligence. You don\'t need to be perfect. But you do need to care deeply. This role blends organizational operations, systems management, and strategic support. You\'ll facilitate team meetings, track KPIs, manage tools like Zenoti and Shopify, coordinate marketing tasks, and keep the founder\'s priorities aligned. This hands-on role is ideal for someone who thrives in structure, demonstrates initiative, and prioritizes clarity and detail. Your responsibilities will include :

Operations & Integrator Coordination : 60% Role Allocation

Team & Operations Management

  • Be the primary support to the Founder in managing day-to-day operations and overall team integration.
  • Be the point of contact for internal issues and help with swift resolution.
  • Help create and implement organizational strategies that support company goals.
  • Lead planning sessions, team meetings, and 1 : 1s; take notes and follow up on action items.
  • Manage projects from start to finish, including timelines, budgets, and delivery.
  • Track team KPIs and tasks, offering support where needed.
  • Prepare reports on Operations and Team Performance for the Founder.
  • Identify ways to improve processes and communication, applying emotional intelligence in communication dynamics.
  • Create and maintain an easy-to-follow Operations Playbook.

System Management & Process Oversight

  • Manage internal tools like Zenoti and Qnity, including employee logs, credentials, client scheduling, cancellations, promo campaigns, etc.
  • Oversee inventory and updates in Zenoti and Shopify, ensuring stock is correct and within budget.
  • Review reports and workflows to find and fix inefficiencies.

Marketing & Content Coordination : 25% Role Allocation

Marketing Coordination

  • Coordinate marketing tasks across departments to keep campaigns on track.
  • Oversee the submission and organization of marketing materials, advertisements, and promotions within Zenoti and Shopify.

Content Curation & Social Media Management

  • Support social media efforts by duplicating and scheduling content (IG, FB, LinkedIn, Google) to align with business initiatives.
  • Write simple copy, quotes, or weekly updates as needed, ensuring consistent brand tone.
  • Monitor engagement and share relevant content ideas as needed.

Strategic Founder & Client Support : 10% Role Allocation

  • Own the Founder\'s calendar, meetings, and priorities; give daily updates.
  • Keep the Founder's email inbox organized, respond to messages, and track follow-ups.
  • Turn the Founder\'s ideas (notes or voice memos) into actionable tasks.
  • Protect the Founder\'s time while supporting the team and aligning priorities.
  • Communicate with clients as needed, handling urgent escalations, urgent follow-ups and building relationships.

What You Should Have

Must-haves :

  • At least seven years of experience in Executive Support, Operations, or Integrator roles, ideally supporting C-level or Founder Executives.
  • Experience supporting a Founder or Executive in a Beauty, Wellness, or Lifestyle brand, particularly in fast-paced, multi-business environments.
  • At least one year of experience in a global remote or virtual environment for a company or with clients in North America, Europe, Australia, or the UAE.
  • Strong integrator and operational management skills, with the ability to translate high-level strategies into actionable plans and workflows.
  • Mastery of English communication skills, both written and verbal, with a professional tone and neutral accent for both internal coordination and client correspondence.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, coordinate with cross-functional teams, and manage day-to-day operations.
  • Client-facing experience, with the ability to handle escalations professionally and maintain relationships.
  • Hands-on experience with Zenoti (or similar scheduling / inventory systems) and Shopify for backend coordination and updates.
  • Experience in light copywriting, editing, and scheduling social media content across IG, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Google platforms.
  • Proficient in remote office tools like Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Calendar) and Slack (or Teams).
  • Experience with project management tools like Asana, Notion, or ClickUp.
  • Proven experience supporting internal operations, maintaining trackers and summary reports (e.g., logins, performance, promos).
  • Exposure to process optimization frameworks, with the ability to implement improvements and create SOPs from scratch.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative without close supervision, and keep executives focused on what matters most.

Technology Specifications :

  • Minimum 100 Mbps Internet Speed
  • Windows 11 or MacOS 15 Sequoia
  • Minimum Intel i5 8th gen with 8GB RAM or Apple M1 chip with 8GB RAM
  • Webcam and Headset
  • Designated Quiet Office Space

Nice-to-haves :

  • Experience with the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS) framework, including L10 meetings, Rocks, Scorecards, and IDS.
  • Basic design knowledge for editing branded visual assets in Canva.

Who You Are

We are hoping you are someone who :

  • Naturally steps in to solve problems, keep things moving, and stays a few steps ahead.
  • Thinks clearly and critically, great at untangling complex challenges, spotting what\'s not working, and helping build smoother systems.
  • Communicates with clarity and confidence, whether giving a quick update to the team or coordinating with external partners, you know how to get the message across with emotional intelligence.
  • Keeps everything (and everyone) on track, juggles timelines, priorities, and moving pieces with calm precision and care for the brand image.

Você é uma pessoa apaixonada pelo que faz e busca um ambiente de trabalho estimulante, onde sua criatividade e habilidades técnicas possam evoluir continuamente? Então, vem somar com a gente!

Estamos em busca de uma Pessoa Product Owner Sênior para para somar com nossa equipe supimpa. Aqui, valorizamos a liberdade e a responsabilidade, encorajando você a trazer suas ideias inovadoras para solucionar desafios de maneira única.

Acreditamos que a soma de expertises e paixão são a chave para o sucesso, e você terá a oportunidade de colaborar com profissionais incríveis que compartilham o mesmo entusiasmo pelo que fazem.

Venha fazer parte do nosso time e aproveitar um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo com somas constantes que farão sua carreira evoluir

Sua jornada de sucesso começa aqui! Nossa soma, sua evolução #vemserilegra

+++ Conheça mais sobre o processo seletivo em nosso playbook

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • ️Disponibilidade para atuar de forma PRESENCIAL em Campinas/SP;
  • Colocar o cliente no centro de todas as decisões, garantindo que os produtos ofereçam soluções superiores às alternativas do mercado;
  • Desenvolver estratégias de produto em colaboração com a alta gestão, visando impacto real nos resultados do negócio;
  • Construir e gerenciar o roadmap estratégico, traduzindo a visão do produto em objetivos claros e alinhados à estratégia;
  • Conduzir iniciativas desde seu conceito à implementação em produção, assegurando entregas eficientes e alinhadas às necessidades do negócio;
  • Acompanhar demandas de sustentação, garantindo a estabilidade e evolução contínua do produto;
  • Coletar e analisar indicadores de desempenho e feedbacks, assegurando uma tomada de decisão baseada em dados;
  • Priorizar e otimizar o backlog, mantendo uma visão clara do impacto das entregas para o negócio e para o cliente;
  • Aplicar os princípios de Lean, Agile e Growth para maximizar a eficiência e inovação nas entregas;
  • Engajar e comunicar-se de forma contínua e eficaz com stakeholders internos e externos;
  • Alinhar iniciativas com outros Product Owners, garantindo que todas as partes envolvidas compartilhem o mesmo entendimento e compromisso com os objetivos estratégicos relacionados às suas demandas;
  • Acompanhar a evolução das iniciativas em conjunto com outros POs, promovendo integração entre os times e assegurando consistência nas entregas;
  • Fomentar uma cultura organizacional ágil dentro da equipe e entre diferentes áreas da empresa;
  • Planejar releases em conjunto com o time de TI e acompanhar métricas de desempenho, garantindo a entrega de valor contínua;
  • Ser referência para outros Product Owners, promovendo boas práticas de produto e contribuindo para o fortalecimento da cultura de produto na organização.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • ️ Disponibilidade para atuação no modelo presencial, em Campinas/SP;
  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner, preferencialmente em projetos complexos;
  • Sólido conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e práticas de Product Discovery e Continuous Discovery;
  • Habilidade em negociação e comunicação eficaz com stakeholders de diferentes níveis;
  • Experiência em análise de dados para embasar decisões estratégicas;
  • Capacidade de liderança e influência para motivar equipes multifuncionais;
  • Foco em resultados e excelência na experiência do usuário;
  • Graduação completa em áreas correlatas;
  • Interesse por inovação e novas tecnologias;
  • Capacidade de adaptação a cenários dinâmicos e mudanças rápidas.

Diferenciais

  • Certificações em Product Owner, Gestão Ágil ou áreas relacionadas;
  • MBA em áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência com produtos financeiros, canais digitais, meios de pagamento ou operações.

Informações adicionais

Conheça nossos benefícios

  • ???? Plano de saúde: Bradesco (outros estados) ou Unimed (RS)
  • Plano odontológico: Bradesco (outros estados) ou Odontoprev (RS)
  • Auxílio home office
  • Auxílio equipamento (para quem optar por usar o próprio para trabalhar)
  • Alelo: Vale alimentação e refeição
  • Zenklub: 2 sessões grátis por mês
  • Wellhub: acesso para você e seus dependentes
  • Guapeco: plano de saúde para o seu pet
  • Apoio em cursos e certificações
  • Open English: desconto em aulas de inglês e espanhol
  • Convênios com instituições de ensino
  • Desconto em farmácias Panvel

Nossa soma, sua evolução!

Nosso propósito é cuidar da coletividade para inspirar pessoas a transformarem o mundo! Somos uma empresa global de estratégia, inovação e tecnologia que desde 2002 combina tecnologia com a paixão das pessoas. E essa soma se transforma em resultados. Nascemos para estimular pessoas e empresas a pensar e ir além. Atuamos em todo o mundo, com um time de quase 300 pessoas ilegranas. Prestamos serviços desde consultorias até projetos completos. Nosso portfólio é centrado em soluções de estratégia e negócios, inovação, data e cloud. Acreditamos que quando existe um senso de coletividade, as pessoas conseguem alcançar a plenitude de seu potencial, pensar além, e assim toda sociedade se beneficia. Nossa soma é o segredo para sua evolução!

title: Kitchen Sales Designer
description:
About the job

We are looking for a talented Kitchen Sales Designer to join our growing team in Latin America. In this role, you’ll help homeowners create kitchens that are both beautiful and practical. You bring a passion for design, sales, and innovation — always keeping the customer at the center. Together with experienced colleagues, you’ll thrive in a dynamic, creative environment.

What is CORNER Renovation?

CORNER is a kitchen brand dedicated to designing and manufacturing high-quality custom kitchens for homeowners worldwide. As a technology-driven company, we develop our own tools to make renovation seamless. With a distributed team in Ukraine and Argentina, and a growing presence across Latin America, we’re expanding quickly and looking for new talent to join us.

Our mission is simple : to help people create the living spaces they dream of. If that resonates with you, we’d love to welcome you to our team.

Requirements

  • Strong sense of our style, with the ability to translate it into innovative, next-level designs that combine functionality and aesthetics.
  • Must have fluent / Advanced English
  • Flexibility to work with clients across different time zones
  • Experience with SketchUp and V-ray
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills, able to drive projects forward independently while maintaining high standards.
  • Good understanding of cabinet construction, hardware and assembly, ensuring designs are practical and production-ready.
  • Proven experience in client-facing roles, with the ability to build trust and guide clients through decision-making
  • 5+ years of work experience in the furniture and kitchen design industry
  • Knowledge of 3ds Max / Corona is a plus

Responsibilities

  • Own the entire project cycle, from company presentation to final design.
  • Keep yourself fully updated on our product range, features, and capabilities, while exploring innovative ways to apply them in design solutions.
  • Develop kitchen and other space designs based on details collected from clients.
  • Conduct online meetings with new and existing clients to understand their requirements.
  • Prepare layouts and design presentations for clients.
  • Provide guidance on efficient kitchen layouts, including the selection of storage solutions.
  • Review technical drawings and orders before production.
  • Assist in selecting appliances, plumbing fixtures, and lighting.
  • Communicate with the internal team to ensure alignment across project details, timelines, and client expectations.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for clients throughout the project, ensuring clear communication, smooth process, and an excellent client experience.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary in USD
  • Professional growth and experience working with international clients
  • Flexible vacation and holiday schedule
  • Company covers 50% of course costs

Looking to work for a fast-growing startup with great career opportunities? We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are ready to work hard, and eager to learn and develop their skills.

After you apply, we will review your application. If it meets our requirements, we will contact you to discuss the details and schedule an interview.

title: Instructional Designer
description:
ADP is hiring a Learning Design Consultant (Instructional Designer).

In this role, you will focus primarily on applying efficient and agile design approaches to develop innovative, engaging learning solutions, using ADP learning design standards and tools, to meet the learning needs of ADP associates and clients.

No two days are the same. You will do everything from creating design documents, testing and deploying content, conducting needs assessments across multiple business lines, establishing training plans, overseeing translations, measuring results, and more. You will do this all to the highest standards with an eye on appealing to multi-generational talent and the modern learner and by partnering across the learning organization to apply innovative techniques in instructional design. You can create compelling content and convey ideas and information to many levels of an organization.

To thrive in the role, you have 3+ years of experience in the learning - development field. You have worked independently to design and develop sound training in various modalities, i.e., eLearning, instructor-led, blended, job aids, and more, and can manage simultaneous projects with deadlines. It would be best to be a continuous learner who focuses on personal development and business process improvement to our design standards. Your work will help our businesses support our clients who employ one to millions of employees.

Like what you see? Apply now!

WHAT YOU'LL DO :

  • Innovation : You seek opportunities to apply innovative design thinking to your projects and will work to keep ADP's approach to designing learning up to date with the products and solutions ADP offers its clients.
  • Flexibility and Agility : You can adapt to changing business requirements, projects, and resources and use agile approaches to meet business needs.
  • Design : You'll design holistic solutions engaging team members and business partners in the design process to ensure the solution design is flexible and addresses the unique needs of the learners. Solution design should consider and factor in how the work environment impacts learning.
  • Development : You can develop solutions across a broad set of learning modalities and tools without creating redundant solutions and ensure that continuous learning and performance support concepts are applied.
  • Learning Outcomes : You measure your outcomes and ensure your learning solutions result in the intended business impact.
  • Continuous Learner : You focus on personal development to develop and elevate professional knowledge and skill. You take the same approach to business process improvement to improve ADP learning design standards and drive the adoption of those standards. You maintain an outside-in perspective by building and maintaining peer networks inside and outside ADP.

TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE :

A college degree is not required but could set you apart. What's more important is having the skills and experience to do the job. You will need 3+ years of experience in instructional development, adult learning theory, and / or technical writing.

Other things that will set you apart :

  • Experience using eLearning tools such as Captivate, Articulate 360 , Synthesia, TechSmith Camtasia , TechSmith SnagIt, Audacity, and Vyond. Technical aptitude to quickly learn new development tools.
  • Experience using a Learning Management System (i.e., Litmos)
  • Experience with simple Graphic Design

    • Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in the learning and development field
  • Ability to systematically design, develop, and implement learning content that meets specific organizational needs
  • Skilled in building learning solutions for English-speaking audiences
  • Proficient in Articulate Storyline, Rise, Synthesia, or similar authoring tools
  • Working knowledge of Learning Management Systems (upload / manage content, apply technical standards, etc.)
  • Proven success collaborating virtually

    • YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN :

  • Collaborate. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and respect one another's ideas to find the best solution.
  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
  • Act like an owner - doer. Mission-driven and committed to navigating change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.

    • Learn more here : https : / / / user / ADPcareers

    What are you waiting for? Apply now!

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (Angular / Sql)
description:
Senior Full Stack Developer (Angular / SQL)

We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Developer with 5+ years of software development experience using Angular, Node.js, and SQL experience to develop analytics dashboard web applications for our industry-leading U.S. client. In this role, you will develop new capabilities in the client's core data product to support its e-commerce service.

Our client is an industry-leading, unified commerce and logistics provider that enables companies with omnichannel commerce capabilities, spanning product discovery to order fulfillment. The company's software, services, and logistics infrastructure serve many of the world's most popular brands, streamlining cross-channel operations and driving more efficient growth. With over 6,000 customers, our client revolutionizes the world of omnichannel commerce

Responsibilities

  • Build solutions to find actionable insights from data and workflow to act on insights
  • Create APIs and UIs for a web-based analytics dashboard application
  • Deliver high-quality, architecturally sound, extensible code
  • Participate in the architecture, coding, and testing of developed systems
  • Assess requirements, discuss, and debate possible solutions
  • Troubleshoot to find and fix bugs
  • Write unit testing (TDD & BDD) and ensure good code coverage

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills (both verbal and written)
  • 5+ years of professional experience developing software with SQL, Angular, and Node.js OR .NET / C#
  • 3+ years of AWS or other cloud platform experience
  • Experience writing 500+ line analytics SQL queries
  • Extensive experience with Angular and Typescript
  • Experience with Node.js, especially the Nest.js framework
  • Built a data dashboard with dynamic tables and charts
  • Fluent in Agile / Scrum
  • Demonstrated ability to work both independently and with a team
  • Track record of building professional, high-quality, and on-time software
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment

Desired Experience

  • CI / CD experience with CircleCI, Jenkins, or similar technologies
  • Writing efficient SQL queries for big-data databases, such as Snowflake
  • Experience with container-based systems, such as Docker and AWS ECS
  • Experience with serverless computing, such as AWS Lambda
  • Familiarity with microservices architectures and DevOps
  • Data management and analytics experience with dbt, FiveTran, and Looker
  • Experience with e-commerce data or analytics applications

Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, learn and grow together!
  • Know your ideas are heard and matter!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with kind, smart, and creative people
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO) per year
  • 8 US holidays, PTO can be used for your local holiday
  • Start : ASAP

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

description:

At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

title: Escalation Manager
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission :

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and / or sales opportunities with key customers.

The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.

In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.

Your Impact

  • Escalation Leadership
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution
  • Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers
  • Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling
  • Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate
  • Expedite Resolution
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues
  • Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it
  • Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner
  • Communication and Reporting
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties
  • Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO
  • Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications
  • Risk Management
  • Make informed decisions on elevating urgency and apply relevant focus to solve for a situation with right governance, guardrails and reviews in place
  • A “whatever it takes” customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Retrospective and Preventive Measures
  • Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process / system / product
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems
  • Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas
  • Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address
  • Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Customer Experience
  • 10+ years of customer-facing sales and / or service delivery roles
  • Past experience as Escalations Engineer / Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired
  • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators
  • Program / Project management
  • Manage critical issues in a cross-functional environment that includes working with support, customer success, professional services, sales, customers, and partners to resolve complex and critical issues
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer
  • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA / SLO / Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like
  • Collaboration and Influence
  • Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers
  • Leadership and communication skills
  • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
  • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Technical skills
  • Experience with Networking / Security Products
  • Knowledge of LAN / WAN technologies, encompassing general routing / switching / security for both branch and data center architectures
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales teams, and other invested parties
  • Creative thinking, adaptability, and versatility
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Strong ability to influence and effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future issues

    • Additional Information

    The Team

    The Escalation Managers are part of the Global Incident and Escalation Management team which part of Global Customer Support and Service teams covering all Palo Alto offerings of cybersecurity platforms and solutions.

    Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making

    As Escalation Managers, each team member will be at the vanguard of our dedication to cybersecurity. Addressing the most pressing situations for our customers, you will hold a central position in solidifying our reputation as the go-to cybersecurity partner. This role demands proactivity, efficiency, an unwavering dedication to constant refinement, and a passion for customer satisfaction.

    Driving continuous learnings and efficiency into the Escalation Management and Product Lifecycle is one of the key areas for the team as we continue our focus on customer experience.

    Our Commitment

    We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple : we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

About This Opportunity

The IT Technical Support Analyst III position provides tier III level support for InComm’s IT Operations Center and core transaction processing platform. IT Operations Center Analysts are responsible for monitoring and assessing potential issues relating to critical IT applications, systems and devices. The IT Technical Support Analyst III will monitor all incoming alerts using various tools and perform actions based on predefined instructions. This position includes performing 1st and 2nd level troubleshooting, manual alert correlation, and resolving issues as required. Team members are expected to monitor and triage production incidents, providing feedback and support throughout the incident lifecycle. Personnel work directly with architecture, infrastructure, application and operational support teams to provide support of day to day maintenance activities such as certificate renewals, network configuration changes, patching, software deployments, etc.

Please note this is a 24/7 support environment and will cover one of several shifts including covering one day on the weekend (either Sun-Thurs or Tues-Sat). General hours listed below: 1st Shift: 6 am - 2 pm est, 2nd Shift: 2 pm - 10 pm est, 3rd Shift: 10 pm - 6 am est. CLT. Fully Remote in Brazil. Benefits include health and dental insurance, meal and restaurant vouchers, fixed monthly stipend for internet and mobile expenses, InComm hardware/software, and annual bonuses!

Responsibilities

  • Monitor key alerts and notifications and drive response and resolution.
  • Participates in the ongoing process of investigating, troubleshooting, and providing resolution to technical issues in a 24x7x365 environment.
  • Quickly develop a comprehensive understanding of the applications and infrastructure within the environment and how they impact employees, partners or customers.
  • Stay informed of production changes that could affect functionality and alerting.
  • Ability to coordinate across teams, working closely with peers to ensure the appropriate focus and sense of urgency is applied to all issues.
  • Accurately troubleshoot, reproduce and document issues and other pertinent information in Incident or Problem tickets.
  • Create and maintain knowledge base article content.
  • Document all problems & issues encountered during the shift and prepare shift turnover document.
  • Handle incident ticket queue and routing of tickets to appropriate support teams.
  • Handle ad hoc requests and take on new procedures as required.
  • Create and maintain team automation and misc. scripts.
  • Identification and execution of monitoring or automation improvements.
  • Assists in other areas of the department and company as necessary.
  • Ability to review network, and system event, and application logs to discern state changes of the environment.
  • Perform routine ticket management and escalations to drive problems to final resolution.
  • Use combination of various tools to correlate multiple faults and/or system presented data into defined events.
  • May provide leadership, coaching, or mentoring to junior level team members.

Qualifications

  • 4-6 years of technical experience in a similar environment reviewing, analyzing, and evaluating the operation of IT systems.
  • Bachelor's degree in CIS, MIS, ideal or must have related field or work experience.
  • Splunk certifications preferred.
  • VMware certifications preferred.
  • Network+ or A+ certification preferred.
  • Basic coding or scripting knowledge such as PowerShell, Python, JavaScript, HTML/CSS preferred.
  • Understanding of TCP/IP and the OSI model.
  • Intermediate to advanced understanding of Unix/Linux OS.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Can handle complex issues and problems with little to no supervisor involvement.
  • Analytical thinking skills and detail oriented.

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Product Designer para transformar a experiência de gestão financeira e fiscal em nosso ERP.

Nosso time de Design de Produto tem papel fundamental na construção dos produtos no Asaas e o seu desafio será participar de todas as etapas de concepção do produto, desde a pesquisa até a finalização da interface, garantindo uma experiência de usuário incrível. Buscamos uma pessoa com autonomia para identificar e implantar alternativas de melhorias, além de acompanhar, planejar, modificar e executar procedimentos.
Se interessou pela oportunidade mas não reside em Joinville? Não tem problema, possibilitamos o trabalho remoto/home office .
Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Dominar metodologias e boas práticas de experiência do usuário e interface;
  • Criar soluções de produto que proporcionem uma jornada clara e compreensível para o nosso cliente;

  • Transformar requisitos técnicos e regulamentares em experiências intuitivas e eficientes.
  • Criar protótipos de baixa e alta fidelidade, wireframes e interfaces visuais consistentes com o design system da empresa.
  • Utilizar métodos de validações das entregas através de testes de usabilidade e teste AB;
  • Colaborar com Product Managers, desenvolvedores e stakeholders para garantir clareza e conformidade das soluções.
  • Conduzir pesquisas com usuários (descoberta, entrevistas, testes de usabilidade) para entender necessidades de clientes.
  • Colaborar na evolução do nosso design system.

Requisitos e qualificações
Requisitos Obrigatórios
  • Demonstrar autonomia e iniciativa;
  • Ter atenção aos detalhes das regras de negócio durante a concepção das soluções;
  • Dominar métodos de pesquisa e entregáveis;
  • Experiência prévia com sistemas ERP de Gestão Financeira;
  • Domínio de ferramentas como Figma (ou similares);
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com fluxos regulamentados, traduzindo regras fiscais em experiências simples;
  • Atuar de forma propositiva, contribuindo ativamente para discussões de produto e decisões de priorização

Qualificações
  • Comunicação clara e assertiva, para argumentar e negociar com stakeholders;
  • Colaboração e trabalho em equipe;
  • Proatividade para se antecipar a problemas, sugerir melhorias, se envolver ativamente na definição do produto;
  • Adaptabilidade as mudanças rápidas de prioridades ou insights;
  • Defender suas ideias com base em dados e experiência, mas sabendo negociar para achar o melhor caminho com PM e TL;
  • Garantir alto nível de refinamento visual (UI) nas entregas.

Informações adicionais
Diferenciais
  • Experiência em produtos financeiros, contábeis, fiscais ou ERP;
  • Experiência em testes de usabilidade com usuários do mercado contábil/financeiro.;
  • Experiência com definição e acompanhamento de métricas de produto;
  • Visão sistêmica para enxergar a modularidade do nosso ERP e conectar com as jornadas do Asaas;
  • Experiencia com mapeamento de jornadas para entender o fluxo do cliente de ponta a ponta.

title: Executivo De Vendas
description:
Sobre a Verzo

A Verzo foi fundada em 2015 com o objetivo de auxiliar os hospitais e prestadores de serviço de saúde a aprimorarem seus resultados financeiros. Iniciamos movidos pelo propósito de ajudar a saúde do Brasil e animados com os desafios que o setor propicia.

Começamos como Aliança Hospitalar, prestando serviços de consultoria para hospitais. Logo nos apaixonamos por tecnologia e criamos o sistema VERZO. Com um time qualificado, o VERZO cresceu de forma exponencial e hoje atuamos com hospitais de todos os portes e perfis em todos os cantos do Brasil. Nos tornamos nativos de tecnologia e adotamos o nome VERZO para nossa companhia.

Durante a pandemia, percebemos o impacto causado não só nas instituições mas também nas pessoas. Decidimos lançar novas soluções de simples adesão, rápida implantação e que facilitassem a vida dos profissionais da área da saúde.

Hoje atendemos os hospitais e redes mais exigentes em termos de tecnologia e resultados. Estamos sempre inovando e criando novas soluções em parcerias com nossos clientes.

Viemos para ficar, valorizamos relações duradouras e a satisfação de nossos clientes é nosso principal objetivo.

O que fazemos

Por meio de ciência de dados proprietária, nossas ferramentas trazem um ROI (retorno do investimento) claro e atrativo, além de apoiarmos as equipes na gestão financeira, cadastro, ciclo de receita, suprimentos e fiscal no atingimento de seus objetivos. Já foram identificados mais de R$ 2 bilhões em oportunidades de aumento de lucro para +350 clientes no país.

Formamos parcerias com essas equipes que, com o uso de nossas ferramentas, entregam mais resultados para seus gestores como redução de glosas / bloqueios, aumento da rentabilidade de medicamentos e materiais médicos, tanto via redução de custos quanto aumento de receita e revisão de mix, e automatização de processos de controle da cadeia de fornecedores e fiscais. Além disso, otimizamos processos internos via tecnologia para liberar tempo da equipe para dedicar atenção e esforços ao que realmente gera valor.

Tudo que desenvolvemos foi com base no feedback das dores destas equipes em diversos hospitais Brasil afora. Conhecemos profundamente as necessidades do setor e sabemos como ajudar.

Prêmios e reconhecimentos

A Verzo é celebrada por sua excelência em inovação e qualidade de serviço. Fomos honrados com diversos reconhecimentos ao longo de nossa história como os destaques de “Tendência para a Saúde em 2024” pela Revista Medicina S / A em 2024, “Top Latin America HealthTech” pela HeathCare Tech Outlook em 2022, e selecionados pela Endeavor como uma das empresas de alto impacto no Brasil por meio do programa Scale Up Endeavor no mesmo ano.

Descrição da vaga e responsabilidades

Estamos em busca de um Executivo de Vendas para integrar nossa equipe. As principais responsabilidades da posição incluem:

  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes.
  • Gerenciar funil de vendas de ponta a ponta: prospecção, qualificação, apresentações, propostas e fechamento.
  • Conduzir reuniões de demonstração do produto.
  • Negociar aspectos comerciais e garantir a melhor experiência do cliente durante o processo comercial.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de Marketing e Customer Success para alinhar estratégias e melhorar a jornada do cliente.
  • Alimentar e organizar o CRM, garantindo previsibilidade de pipeline.
  • Atingir e superar metas de vendas.

Local de trabalho

O trabalho será remoto, permitindo desempenho das funções de onde desejar. Por vezes, haverá necessidade de viagens para eventos e encontros presenciais com clientes.

Regime de contratação:

Contrato PJ.

Requisitos mínimos

Ao liderar iniciativas de desenvolvimento de negócios, você desempenha um papel crucial no crescimento da Verzo e na melhoria contínua da saúde no Brasil. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para o sucesso dos hospitais parceiros, proporcionando resultados tangíveis e impactando positivamente a qualidade dos serviços de saúde oferecidos.

  • Disponibilidade para participação em eventos e encontros presenciais que envolvam viagens.
  • Imersão no entendimento dos produtos da Verzo e nas metodologias de vendas, com foco em SPICED, SPIN e CHALLENGER SALE.

O que valorizamos

  • Experiência prévia no setor de saúde.
  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo e orientado a resultados.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente dinâmico e de rápido crescimento.
  • Interesse genuíno em gerar impacto positivo no setor de saúde, via inovação, inteligência de dados e tecnologia.

Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você e explorar como podemos construir uma jornada de sucesso juntos.

Se você está em busca de uma oportunidade de crescimento em uma empresa que valoriza a inovação e a excelência na saúde, a Verzo é o lugar ideal para você. Venha fazer parte do nosso time e contribuir com a vida!

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho :

  • Fornecer suporte técnico direto aos clientes focados na solução de Comércio Exterior (OSGT - OneSource Global Trade);
  • Utilizar a linguagem PL / SQL como base principal para todas as análises e investigações, criação de scripts para pequenas rotinas de manutenção;
  • Realizar investigações técnicas (debug) em PL / SQL com banco de dados ORACLE;
  • Atuar diretamente no monitoramento e troubleshooting das Integrações entre a OSGT;
  • Prestar atendimento ao cliente via telefone e / ou Teams, solucionando dúvidas e eventuais problemas da versão de forma eficaz;

  • Analisar e documentar toda da análise técnica e funcional realizada para compartilhamento aos times de desenvolvimento.

O que você precisa ter :

  • Experiência como analista de suporte ao sistema OSGT (ONESOURCE Global Trade), nos módulos de Import, Export, Cambio Import e Cambio Export;
  • Experiência em PL / SQL para suporte técnico (debug de objetos base).

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

In this role, you will focus primarily on applying efficient and agile design approaches to develop innovative, engaging learning solutions, using ADP learning design standards and tools, to meet the learning needs of ADP associates and clients.

No two days are the same. You will do this all to the highest standards with an eye on appealing to multi-generational talent and the modern learner and by partnering across the learning organization to apply innovative techniques in instructional design. You can create compelling content and convey ideas and information to many levels of an organization.

To thrive in the role, you have 3+ years of experience in the learning - development field. You have worked independently to design and develop sound training in various modalities, i.e., eLearning, instructor-led, blended, job aids, and more, and can manage simultaneous projects with deadlines. It would be best to be a continuous learner who focuses on personal development and business process improvement to our design standards. Your work will help our businesses support our clients who employ one to millions of employees.

Like what you see? Apply now!

  • Learning Outcomes : You measure your outcomes and ensure your learning solutions result in the intended business impact.
  • Continuous Learner : You focus on personal development to develop and elevate professional knowledge and skill. You take the same approach to business process improvement to improve ADP learning design standards and drive the adoption of those standards. You maintain an outside-in perspective by building and maintaining peer networks inside and outside ADP.

TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE :

A college degree is not required but could set you apart. What's more important is having the skills and experience to do the job. You will need 3+ years of experience in instructional development, adult learning theory, and / or technical writing.

title: Escalation Manager
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission :

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and / or sales opportunities with key customers.

The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.

In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.

Your Impact

  • Escalation Leadership
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution
  • Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers
  • Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling
  • Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate
  • Expedite Resolution
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues
  • Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it
  • Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner
  • Communication and Reporting
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties
  • Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO
  • Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications
  • Risk Management
  • Make informed decisions on elevating urgency and apply relevant focus to solve for a situation with right governance, guardrails and reviews in place
  • A “whatever it takes” customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Retrospective and Preventive Measures
  • Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process / system / product
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems
  • Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas
  • Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address
  • Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Customer Experience
  • 10+ years of customer-facing sales and / or service delivery roles
  • Past experience as Escalations Engineer / Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired
  • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators
  • Program / Project management
  • Manage critical issues in a cross-functional environment that includes working with support, customer success, professional services, sales, customers, and partners to resolve complex and critical issues
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer
  • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA / SLO / Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like
  • Collaboration and Influence
  • Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers
  • Leadership and communication skills
  • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
  • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Technical skills
  • Experience with Networking / Security Products
  • Knowledge of LAN / WAN technologies, encompassing general routing / switching / security for both branch and data center architectures
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales teams, and other invested parties
  • Creative thinking, adaptability, and versatility
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Strong ability to influence and effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future issues

    • Additional Information

    The Team

    The Escalation Managers are part of the Global Incident and Escalation Management team which part of Global Customer Support and Service teams covering all Palo Alto offerings of cybersecurity platforms and solutions.

    Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making

    As Escalation Managers, each team member will be at the vanguard of our dedication to cybersecurity. Addressing the most pressing situations for our customers, you will hold a central position in solidifying our reputation as the go-to cybersecurity partner. This role demands proactivity, efficiency, an unwavering dedication to constant refinement, and a passion for customer satisfaction.

    Driving continuous learnings and efficiency into the Escalation Management and Product Lifecycle is one of the key areas for the team as we continue our focus on customer experience.

    Our Commitment

    We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple : we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

Na Remessa Online, não se trata apenas de transferências internacionais, criamos conexões que rompem fronteiras e transformam realidades. Somos movidos pela ousadia, respeito, colaboração, encantamento e responsabilidade.

Nosso segredo? Trabalhar juntos com transparência, comprometimento e autonomia, sempre buscando a melhor solução. Estamos revolucionando o cenário financeiro global, e você pode fazer parte dessa jornada conosco!

Como vai ser o seu dia a dia

Você fará parte do time B2C, responsável por desenvolver e evoluir nossa plataforma para clientes pessoa física. Aqui, o foco é ativação, conversão, retenção e performance. Trabalhamos em um ambiente colaborativo, ágil e desafiador, onde você terá espaço para inovar e influenciar diretamente o futuro da nossa plataforma.

  • Construir e evoluir a plataforma B2C, transformando regras de negócio em soluções de alto impacto;
  • Trabalhar com Next.js, React e TypeScript para criar aplicações escaláveis, rápidas e responsivas;
  • Ser referência técnica do time: revisar código, orientar colegas e apoiar decisões estratégicas;
  • Participar ativamente da concepção de produtos, decisões de arquitetura e cerimônias ágeis;
  • Garantir qualidade no código com testes, documentação e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Acompanhar e apoiar o desenvolvimento de carreira do time, com 1:1s, feedbacks e PDIs;
  • Propor soluções criativas e ousadas que melhorem a experiência do cliente;
  • Contribuir para melhorias contínuas em processos, arquitetura e cultura de engenharia.

O que você precisa saber para se juntar ao nosso time

  • Base sólida em boas práticas de desenvolvimento e excelência técnica;
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis e todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento de software (SDLC);
  • Atuação próxima a times de Produto, participando da concepção de soluções;
  • Experiência com mentoria e desenvolvimento de engenheiros;
  • Conhecimento em testes unitários e de integração;
  • Domínio em Next.js, React.js, Node.js, JavaScript e TypeScript;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura em camadas e/ou hexagonal;
  • Prática em CI/CD, Docker e cultura DevOps;
  • Vivência com programação concorrente, serviços distribuídos e mensageria (pub/sub, queue, stream);
  • Experiência em Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).

O que oferecemos

  • Contrato CLT – Todos os direitos garantidos.
  • Bônus por metas – Recebimento de bônus atrelado ao cumprimento de objetivos organizacionais.
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico – Cobertura para você e seus dependentes via SulAmérica.
  • VR e VA flexíveis – Créditos no Caju para usar como quiser.
  • Auxílio Home Office – Suporte para despesas e equipamentos.
  • Auxílio Creche – Apoio para mães e pais.
  • Licenças Estendidas – Maternidade e paternidade ampliadas para você aproveitar esse momento especial.
  • Auxílio Dependentes – Suporte para quem tem dependentes com necessidades especiais.
  • Seguro de Vida – Tranquilidade e segurança para você.
  • Descontos na Remessa Online – Para viver sem fronteiras!
  • Bem-estar e saúde – Consultas online com psicólogos e nutricionistas via Conexa Saúde e Psicologia Viva.
  • Wellhub – Acesso a academias e serviços como mindfulness, nutrição e terapia.
  • Apoio ao Empregado (EAP) – Suporte especializado sempre que precisar.
  • Day Off no Aniversário – Seu dia especial merece folga!
  • Ciclo de Desenvolvimento e Treinamentos – Desafios, capacitações e avaliação 360° para impulsionar sua carreira.

Atuação

Remoto: Trabalhe de onde quiser! Se preferir um escritório, temos espaço em São Paulo. Flexibilidade é o nosso lema.

Diversidade e inclusão: Construindo o Futuro!

Acreditamos que a diversidade nos fortalece e nos impulsiona a ir além. Aqui, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas! Queremos um ambiente onde cada voz seja ouvida, cada experiência valorizada e cada contribuição faça a diferença.

Mais do que um compromisso, essa é a nossa realidade: um lugar acolhedor, respeitoso e representativo, onde juntos construímos um futuro mais justo, inclusivo e inspirador.

Descubra mais sobre a Remessa Online.

Saiba mais sobre nós no nosso site e acompanhe nosso time no LinkedIn.

Vem ser #SouRemessa e fazer parte da equipe que transforma o mundo com ousadia, colaboração e responsabilidade!

title: Lead, Payroll
description:
Provides support to the Global Payroll Department and ensures the timely and accurate processing of payroll records by compiling, organizing, reviewing, and entering data in global payroll systems as necessary, with a focus in USA, Canada and Costa Rica payrolls. A team player who can identify opportunities and work with the team or business partner to document, resolve and create SOP’s. Ability to pivot as needed with priorities arise and flexible enough to support global implementations of software.

This is a remote position for candidates in Costa Rica, which may require occasional in-person attendance at work-related events at the discretion of management.

What You'll Bring:

  • Manages the end-to-end payroll processing for US, Canada and Costa Rica. With potential to increase scope as shared services matures.
  • Team lead for team processing payrolls.
  • Partners with internal and external payroll business partners on all items related to payroll and payroll tax items, resolves issues timely with high level of accuracy.
  • Reviews quarterly and year-end payroll reporting (941s, W-2, T-4, etc.)
  • Ability to create and review SOP for global payroll playbook.
  • Leads and tracks payroll audits following TransUnion’s standard practices to ensure associates are paid accurately and timely
  • Ability to autonomously analyze and resolve complex associate inquiries and issues in a timely manner and effectively communicate back to associates.
  • Perform other duties as identified or as assigned
  • Partners with Sr. Director of payroll on KPI, process improvements, and documentation with a eye on continuous improvement.

Impact You'll Make:

What You Bring to the Table:

  • Strong oral and written communication, organizational and analytical skills. Effectively shares/diseminates information; listens to others and incorporates/integrates information.
  • Proficient in excel with the ability to create and analyze reports for efficient, streamline payroll operations.
  • Experience in USA, Canada and Costa Rica payroll laws.
  • Experience in global implementation and ability to follow project plans.
  • Excellent customer service orientation and team player.
  • Must be able to meet established deadlines, while working with a sense of urgency and strong attention to detail. Able to juggle multiple priorities at one time.
  • A self-starter, with the ability to quickly change course and adapt to meet business needs.
  • Positive and consistent attitude; good sense of humor is a plus!

The Fine Print:

  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced team environment
  • Ability to manage priorities and workflow
  • Excellent analytical skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to handle confidential data
  • Ability to continuously improve
  • Ability to meet critical deadlines
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office products; especially Excel (should be able to perform X-lookups, create pivot tables, etc.), with ability to analyze data
  • 3-5 years of payroll experience in USA, Canada and Costa Rica including multi-state, quarterly and annual reporting of W-2, understanding of providences, and T-4, Global Payroll experience a plus
  • Experience with global systems such as Workday, ADP, Alight, UKG, etc.

TransUnion is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Netsuite Accountant
description:
Staff Accountant (Remote) – USA Clients

Location : Remote – Brazil

Salary : USD 1,700 / month

Schedule : 40 hours / week

About Us

We are a dynamic and growing U.S.-based accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for a Staff Accountant with NetSuite experience and strong process enhancement and implementation skills to join our remote team. If you're detail-oriented and passionate about financial reporting, budgeting, and variance analysis, this is your chance to work with top-tier US clients.

Key Responsibilities

The Staff Accountant is responsible for following the TGG Way standards for processing and implementing the day-to-day transactional accounting to produce complete and accurate financial statements. The Staff Accountant is required to build and maintain positive relationships with clients, clients’ staff, co-workers, and managers. Understanding source documents, inputting them, and filing them correctly is a key part of the Staff Accountant’s job. Using critical thinking and having a proficiency in intermediate accounting, the Staff Accountant is responsible for the accurate data entry of all transactions into the accounting system.

Responsibilities

  • Accounts Payable & Receivable: Processing invoices, applying payments, and reconciling transactions accurately and efficiently.
  • Bank & Credit Card Reconciliations: Performing soft reconciliations weekly and hard reconciliations monthly, ensuring accuracy in coding and matching transactions. Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and intercompany accounts in NetSuite.
  • Month-End Workbooks: Preparing and reconciling schedules for various accounts such as AR, AP, payroll accruals, loans, and fixed assets. Execute timely and accurate month-end close processes under tight deadlines.
  • Financial Reporting: Mapping accounts, syncing data, and generating financial reports using TGG templates. Analyze and review month-over-month income statements, making necessary adjustments (e.g., prepaid expenses, accrued expenses, fixed assets, and managing cash flow).
  • NetSuite: Utilize NetSuite for bank feeds, reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable processing, generating reports, and posting journal entries. This includes running balance sheets and profit & loss reports, entering invoices and bills, and creating customers and vendors.
  • Communication and Task Management: Using Asana to update and manage tasks and Bizinta for time entries with detailed descriptions.

Requirements

  • 2–3 years of accounting or finance experience doing month-end close processes, bank reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.
  • Education: Accounting or Finance degree preferred.
  • Technical Knowledge: Strong proficiency in NetSuite (or similar ERP) and Excel.
  • Strong background in process enhancement, process implementation, and system optimization.
  • Communication: Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent attention to detail and analytical skills.
  • Strong understanding of debits / credits, journal entries, and accrual-based accounting.
  • US GAAP knowledge required; IFRS familiarity is a plus.
  • Experience working with European entities is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.
  • Working Equipment to start is required.
  • Working hours based on client

Perks & Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO Policy, including all Holidays.
  • 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and NetSuite.
  • Full access to TGG University and learning materials.
  • Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities.

About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

Our Core Values

  • Loyalty
  • Integrity
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
  • Team Player / Caring / Selfless
  • Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
  • Freedom & Accountability

description:
Analista Planejamento e Custo de Obras Sênior

Descrição da vaga

No time de Planejamento e Controle de Obras você terá como desafio receber e analisar os custos de obras (Brasil) desdobrando em indicadores, através de planilhas e utilização de sistema interno, gerando a melhor informação possível aos stackholders para tomada de decisões.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Custos de obras: Monitorar os custos das obras em comparativo ao orçamento. Assim estar apto a fazer levantamento de projetos, definição de escopo de contratação, para controle de célula e apoio a obra
  • Incorrido de obras: Analisar os valores incorridos das obras através do sistema interno proporcionando alocação correta em todos projetos e consequentemente o correto andamento financeiro das obras;
  • Auditoria: Participar em conjunto do gestor da área na preparação dos documentos solicitados pela auditoria através do sistema interno e rede interna da área visando atender com excelência as exigências do controle apurado pela auditoria;
  • Indicadores: Contribuir com análises, geração de indicadores e apuração do banco de dados através dos sistemas e controles vigentes com o propósito de auxiliar o gestor da área na melhora constante da informação e visibilidade que é repassada aos gestores de operações;
  • Erp: Atender as áreas internas com operações técnicas, via sistema da empresa, proporcionando aos clientes internos as informações no prazo correto além da orientação sistema que é realizada.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia Civil, Arquitetura e Urbanismo, Administração de Empresas ou Finanças;
  • Pacote office intermediário;
  • Vivência com SAP;
  • Imprescindível experiência com planejamento e controle de custos de obras.
  • Desejável ter conhecimento em Dashboards, Powerbi e em IA.

Informações adicionais

  • Vale refeição e/ou Refeição;
  • Vale transporte ou Auxílio Combustível;
  • Plano de saúde Sul américa;

  • Adicional de 1 mês de licença maternidade não remunerada;
  • Licença paternidade estendida;
  • Gympass;
  • Previdência de Privada;
  • Clube de parcerias.

Somos a Alea. A nova marca da Construtora Tenda.

Colocamos a casa dos sonhos ao alcance de quem nem sabia que podia sonhar! Mais do que a casa própria, produzimos um produto inimaginável, com uma proposta de valor diferenciada para o mercado de habitação popular, entregando casas de muita qualidade no modelo de condomínio fechado, com conceito de urbanismo diferenciado.

A gente acredita que dignidade e felicidade é para todos. Por isso, oferecemos condições de pagamento sob medida para todos os bolsos, através da parceria com o Casa Verde e Amarela, parcelas de financiamento menores e taxas de juros reduzidas.

Somos um time de alta performance e nos desafiamos a fazer diferente para alcançar o que parece impossível. Por isso, acreditamos que todos devem e podem inovar. Temos obsessão por eficiência e buscamos o alto desempenho através da abordagem industrial da construção civil, aliada à cultura de melhoria contínua e lifelong learning.

Gostamos de trabalhar de um jeito descomplicado, e valorizamos o jeito simples de ser e agir. O nosso jeito é leve, parceiro e amigo. Aqui nós celebramos nossas conquistas, reconhecemos e valorizamos os talentos que partilham da nossa cultura, entregam resultados consistentes e nos provocam a evoluir. Afinal, são as nossas pessoas que fazem tudo acontecer.

title: Product Designer
description:
We're looking for a Product Designer (UI/UX) to help define and shape the user experience across our marketplace and subscription products, reporting directly to the founders. This role blends creativity and problem-solving. You'll be responsible for turning complex workflows into intuitive, beautiful, and user-friendly interfaces. The ideal candidate is highly collaborative, user-obsessed, and motivated to create impactful designs that get shipped quickly.

This is the perfect role for someone hungry to make a visible impact at a growth-stage company. You'll have full ownership of design projects end-to-end, working closely with product and engineering to ship designs that touch hundreds of thousands of users.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the full design lifecycle from research, wireframing, prototyping, to final UI delivery
  • Translate user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant product experiences
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and founders to scope and prioritize design solutions
  • Create wireframes, flows, and interactive prototypes to communicate design decisions
  • Maintain and evolve a consistent design system to ensure scalability and cohesion
  • Advocate for the user experience while balancing business priorities
  • Iterate quickly on designs based on user data, feedback, and product KPIs
  • Deliver high-quality visual designs and assets ready for implementation

Requirements:

  • Proven experience as a Product Designer, UI/UX Designer, or similar role at a SaaS, marketplace, or product-led growth company
  • Strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end product design work, including both UX and UI
  • Proficiency with modern design tools (Figma or similar)
  • Strong understanding of usability principles, interaction design, and responsive layouts
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across cross-functional teams
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with limited resources
  • Self-sufficient and accountable to deadlines
  • Proficient in English and located in North or South America

Not mandatory, but highly valued:

  • Previous experience with 2-sided marketplaces
  • Experience designing marketing websites or landing pages
  • Graphic design experience (e.g. marketing assets, social media, or brand visuals)
  • Experience with motion/interaction design or rapid prototyping tools
  • Front-end development knowledge (HTML/CSS/JS) to better communicate with engineers

Benefits:

  • Fully remote role with a strong emphasis on asynchronous work
  • $2,000-$3,500 USD/month
  • 2 weeks paid vacation
  • Annual cash performance bonus based on the growth and performance of the company
  • Significant growth potential in both role and compensation as we continue to scale

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all qualified candidates.

Aqui, trabalho é esforço, resultado e entrega.
